headline.text: Lamp repair morning at Fernhollow Repair Cafe, then bakery treats and a library hold

narrative.text: Your day began at home with a quiet breakfast: oatmeal with banana slices, tea, and an open notebook showing a hand-drawn lamp wiring sketch. You talked through the lamp base and switch while getting ready, then gathered an umbrella and jacket before heading out.
You rode the tram toward Fernhollow, keeping your tote and ticket close on Line 4. Around midday, you paused the recording for a break, planning to return at one.

At Fernhollow Repair Cafe, you worked with a volunteer to diagnose the cracked rocker switch in your desk lamp. The two of you opened the base, checked the cord with a multimeter, and confirmed the switch was the main problem. Since the exact replacement wasn't on hand, you ordered one and left the lamp on the waiting-for-parts shelf.

Later, you stopped at Quill Street Bakery for a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns, then visited Larkspur Community Library. The library desk confirmed your reserved lamp repair manual would be ready Tuesday afternoon and renewed your card for another year.
